quote: In the Transformer this is reduced to a constant number of operations, albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions
claim: 在 Transformer 中，关联任意两个位置信号所需的操作数被降为常数，但代价是有效分辨率降低，这是由于对注意力加权位置做了平均 [S2.p1]。

quote: In this work we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output.
claim: 作者提出 Transformer，完全摒弃循环，仅依靠注意力机制来建立输入与输出之间的全局依赖 [S1.p4]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths, as memory constraints limit batching across examples.
claim: 循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置分解计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 训练使用标准的 WMT 2014 英德数据集，约 450 万句对，采用字节对编码，共享源-目标词表约 37000 个 token；英法则使用更大的 WMT 2014 英法数据集，包含 3600 万句，并切分为 32000 个 word-piece 词表 [S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We implement this inside of scaled dot-product attention by masking out (setting to $-\infty$) all values in the input of the softmax which correspond to illegal connections.
claim: 模型以多头注意力在三种方式下使用：编码器-解码器注意力层中查询来自上一层解码器、键和值来自编码器输出；编码器包含自注意力层，其键、值、查询均来自上一层编码器输出；解码器自注意力层允许每个位置关注到该位置及之前的所有位置，并通过掩码将非法连接对应的 softmax 输入置为负无穷以保持自回归性质 [S3.SS2.SSS3.p1]。

quote: We evaluate the representation learning capabilities of ResNet, Vision Transformer (ViT), and the hybrid.
claim: 实验评估了 ResNet、ViT 和混合模型的表示学习能力，在不同规模的数据集上预训练并在多个基准任务上评测 [S4.p1]。

quote: In order to perform classification, we use the standard approach of adding an extra learnable “classification token” to the sequence.
claim: 方法上，作者尽可能遵循原始 Transformer 的设计，将图像切分为图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.p1]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 方法上，作者尽可能遵循原始 Transformer 的设计，将图像切分为图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.p1]。

quote: In model design we follow the original Transformer as closely as possible.
claim: 方法上，作者尽可能遵循原始 Transformer 的设计，将图像切分为图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列送入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1][S3.p1]。

quote: Our Vision Transformer (ViT) attains excellent results when pre-trained at sufficient scale and transferred to tasks with fewer datapoints.
claim: 主要结论是：在足够规模的数据上预训练后，大规模训练胜过归纳偏置，ViT 在多个图像识别基准上接近或超过当时最优结果 [S1.p5]。

quote: Additionally, providing provenance for their decisions and updating their world knowledge remain open research problems.
claim: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们虽能在参数中存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，性能落后于任务特定架构，且为其决策提供出处和更新世界知识仍是未解决问题 [abstract]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们虽能在参数中存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，性能落后于任务特定架构，且为其决策提供出处和更新世界知识仍是未解决问题 [abstract]。

quote: We explore a general-purpose fine-tuning recipe for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) — models which combine pre-trained parametric and non-parametric memory for language generation.
claim: 论文关注预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上的局限：它们虽能在参数中存储事实知识，但访问和精确操作知识的能力仍有限，性能落后于任务特定架构，且为其决策提供出处和更新世界知识仍是未解决问题 [abstract]。

quote: The second approach, RAG-Token, can predict each target token based on a different document.
claim: 为端到端训练检索器与生成器，作者将检索到的文档视为隐变量，并提出两种对隐文档进行边缘化的模型 [S2.p2]。

quote: We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
claim: 开放域问答方面，作者在 Natural Questions、TriviaQA、WebQuestions 和 CuratedTrec 四个数据集上评估，使用与先前工作相同的训练/开发/测试划分并报告 Exact Match 分数；由于 CT 和 WQ 较小，作者按 DPR 做法用 NQ RAG 模型初始化 CT 和 WQ 模型 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error
claim: 作者承认，在 CIFAR-10 上 1202 层网络的测试结果差于 110 层网络，尽管两者训练误差相近，作者认为这是过拟合所致，1202 层网络对该小数据集可能过大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: Recent evidence reveals that network depth is of crucial importance
claim: 作者指出，深度对图像分类至关重要，但简单地堆叠更多层并不容易带来更好的网络 [S1.p1][S1.p2]。

quote: The 1202-layer network may be unnecessarily large (19.4M) for this small dataset
claim: 作者承认，在 CIFAR-10 上 1202 层网络的测试结果差于 110 层网络，尽管两者训练误差相近，作者认为这是过拟合所致，1202 层网络对该小数据集可能过大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: Our 152-layer residual net is the deepest network ever presented on ImageNet, while still having lower complexity than VGG nets
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 分类数据集上评估了极深残差网络，其中 152 层残差网络是当时 ImageNet 上最深网络，复杂度仍低于 VGG [S1.p9]。

quote: Our ensemble has 3.57% top-5 error on the ImageNet test set, and won the 1st place in the ILSVRC 2015 classification competition
claim: 在 ImageNet 测试集上，残差网络集成取得 3.57% top-5 错误率，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 分类任务第一名 [S1.p9]。

quote: Figure 1 (a) depicts the performance trajectory of DeepSeek-R1-Zero on the AIME 2024 benchmark throughout the RL training process, where the average pass@1 score on AIME 2024 shows a significant increase, jumping from an initial 15.6% to 77.9%.
claim: 论文在AIME 2024基准上追踪了DeepSeek-R1-Zero在RL训练过程中的性能变化，并报告了pass@1和自洽解码结果 [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: General dataset consists of 66k questions designed to assess helpfulness, spanning various categories such as creative writing, editing, factual question answering, and role-playing.
claim: 训练数据涵盖数学（26k定量推理题）、编码（17k算法竞赛题和8k bug修复问题）、STEM（22k选择题）、逻辑（15k题）和通用（66k题）等多个领域 [A2.SS3.SSS1.p2]。

quote: DeepSeek-R1-Zero naturally learns to solve reasoning tasks with more thinking time.
claim: 模型在训练中自然学会用更多思考时间解决推理任务，响应长度稳步增加 [S2.F1][S2.SS3.p4]。

quote: In addition, by leveraging the self-consistency decoding, the model’s performance can be further improved, achieving an accuracy of 86.7%.
claim: 论文在AIME 2024基准上追踪了DeepSeek-R1-Zero在RL训练过程中的性能变化，并报告了pass@1和自洽解码结果 [S2.SS3.p2]。

quote: When evaluating DeepSeek-R1, we observe that it is sensitive to prompts. Few-shot prompting consistently degrades its performance.
claim: 模型对提示敏感，少样本提示会持续降低其性能 [S6.p6]。

quote: Thus, we ask: what is the simplest approach to achieve both test-time scaling and strong reasoning performance?
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在 OpenAI o1 未公开方法、众多复现尝试均未公开复现出清晰测试时扩展行为的情况下，实现测试时扩展与强推理性能的最简单方法是什么 [S1.p1]。

quote: We perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) of an off-the-shelf pretrained model on our small dataset
claim: 作者构建了 s1K 数据集，包含 1,000 道经过筛选的问题及其从 Gemini Thinking Experimental 蒸馏出的推理轨迹和答案，并对现成预训练模型进行监督微调 [S1.p2]。

quote: Suppressing the end-of-thinking token delimiter too often can lead the model into repetitive loops instead of continued reasoning.
claim: 作者还提到，过于频繁地抑制思考结束符可能导致模型陷入重复循环而非继续推理 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: We measure three metrics
claim: 作者定义了 Control、Scaling、Performance 三项指标，通过在固定基准（如 AIME24）上变化测试时计算量得到分段线性函数来评估各方法 [S3.SS2.p1]。

quote: our model s1-32B exceeds o1-preview on competition math questions by up to 27% (MATH and AIME24)
claim: 作者在竞赛数学基准上评估模型，包括 MATH 和 AIME24 [abstract]。

quote: We select three sets of 500 problems with increasing difficulty: Simple-500 (MATH levels 1-2), Complex-500 (MATH levels 3-5), and Advanced-500 (AIME problems).
claim: 作者还做了多项对照实验：比较不同质量推理链、比较 Simple-500（MATH 1-2 级）、Complex-500（MATH 3-5 级）、Advanced-500（AIME 题）三组各 500 题的难度梯度 [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；用相同 LIMO 数据微调 Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 以考察预训练数据影响 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p1]；以及比较不同模型规模和不同数据集规模下的表现 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: Dataset quality depends on both question quality and solution quality.
claim: 论文聚焦于答案可验证的推理任务，将推理过程形式化为由中间步骤组成的推理链，并认为数据质量同时取决于问题质量和解答质量 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: We evaluate performance using the pass@1 metric in a zero-shot chain-of-thought setting across all benchmarks.
claim: 评估采用零样本思维链设置下的 pass@1 指标：对 MATH500、OlympiadBench、Gaokao、Kaoyan、GradeSchool、MinervaMath、GPQA 等较大基准使用贪心解码单次采样，对 AIME24、AMC23、CHMath 等少于 50 题的较小基准生成 4 个样本（temperature=0.6）并计算无偏 pass@1，数值答案用规则评估、复杂答案格式用 LLM 评估器，最大输出长度均为 32,768 token [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: we observe diminishing returns beyond 800 samples
claim: 作者指出，超过 800 个样本后收益递减，最大数据集规模 2k 相比 1.6k 提升很小，表明超过某一阈值后额外数据对微调增益贡献较小 [S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: We SFT both models using identical LIMO datasets and evaluate on AIME2024 and MATH500 benchmarks.
claim: 作者还做了多项对照实验：比较不同质量推理链、比较 Simple-500（MATH 1-2 级）、Complex-500（MATH 3-5 级）、Advanced-500（AIME 题）三组各 500 题的难度梯度 [S6.SS3.SSS2.p1]；用相同 LIMO 数据微调 Qwen1.5-32B-Chat 与 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 以考察预训练数据影响 [S6.SS3.SSS3.p1]；以及比较不同模型规模和不同数据集规模下的表现 [S6.SS3.SSS4.p1][S6.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

quote: We argue that LM agents represent a new category of end user, with their own needs and abilities.
claim: 作者指出，将智能体应用于软件工程这类更复杂代码任务仍未被充分探索，而现有界面是为人类用户设计的 [S1.p1][S2.p1]。

quote: Inspired by human-computer interaction (HCI) studies on the efficacy of user interfaces for humans, we investigate whether LM agents could similarly benefit from better-designed interfaces for performing software engineering tasks.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：界面设计如何影响语言模型智能体的性能，以及 LM 智能体是否能像人类工程师从强大软件应用中受益那样，从专门设计的界面中受益 [abstract][S1.p1]。

quote: In this paper, we assume a fixed LM and focus on designing the ACI to improve its performance.
claim: 论文提出 agent-computer interface（ACI）概念，并在固定 LM 权重的前提下，通过设计 ACI 来提升智能体性能 [S1.p5][S2.p4]。

quote: However, applying agents to more complex code tasks like software engineering remains unexplored.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：界面设计如何影响语言模型智能体的性能，以及 LM 智能体是否能像人类工程师从强大软件应用中受益那样，从专门设计的界面中受益 [abstract][S1.p1]。

quote: First, we introduce the concept of the agent-computer interface (ACI) and demonstrate how careful ACI design can substantially improve LM agent performance without modifying the underlying LM’s weights.
claim: 论文提出 agent-computer interface（ACI）概念，并在固定 LM 权重的前提下，通过设计 ACI 来提升智能体性能 [S1.p5][S2.p4]。

quote: We evaluate 1) whether Quiet-STaR improves a language model’s ability to directly predict answers in datasets that require reasoning; and, 2) the distribution of impacts resulting from thinking tokens.
claim: 实验以 Mistral 7B 基础版本为起点 [S5.p1]。

quote: Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
claim: Quiet-STaR 带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前要生成许多 token [S6.p2]。

quote: We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
claim: 大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，作者预期该语料包含更高密度的受益于推理的 token [S5.p2]。

quote: QA datasets, especially high-quality ones, require thoughtful curation and will inherently only ever cover a subset of reasoning tasks.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：STaR 等方法依赖人工整理的问答数据集来学习推理，这限制了理由的规模和泛化性，因为高质量问答数据集只能覆盖推理任务的一个子集 [S1.p2]。

quote: training with Quiet-STaR on C4 also improves performance on GSM8K ( $5.9\%\rightarrow 8.1\%$) and CommonsenseQA ( $36.3\%\rightarrow 42.6\%$) but by a smaller margin.
claim: 在 C4 上训练也带来提升，但幅度较小：GSM8K 从 5.9% 到 8.1%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 到 42.6% [S5.SS1.p2]。

quote: We demonstrate that scaling inference compute through repeated sampling leads to large improvements in coverage across a variety of tasks and models.
claim: 重复采样在多种任务和模型上大幅提升覆盖率，使弱模型通过大量样本有可能超越更强模型的单次采样 [S1.p12]。

quote: In this work, we explore repeated sampling (Figure 1) as a simple approach to scaling inference compute in order to improve reasoning performance.
claim: 论文采用重复采样（repeated sampling）作为扩展推理计算量的简单方法，即从模型中独立生成多个候选解 [S1.p3]。

quote: MiniF2F-MATH: A dataset of mathematics problems that have been formalized into proof checking languages. We use Lean4 as our language, and evaluate on the 130 test set problems that are formalized from the MATH dataset.
claim: 论文在多个数据集上评估：GSM8K（随机选取 128 道测试题）、MATH（128 道随机测试题）、MiniF2F-MATH（使用 Lean4，评估 130 道由 MATH 形式化的测试题）、CodeContests（要求用 Python3 编写解答）以及 SWE-bench Lite（真实 GitHub 问题，需编辑代码库，用单元测试自动检查）[S2.p4]。

quote: Our goal is to systematically characterize these benefits across a range of tasks, models, and sample budgets.
claim: 作者希望系统性地刻画重复采样在多种任务、模型和样本预算下带来的收益 [S1.p3]。

quote: Based on these results, we selected a temperature of 1.6 for our main experiments.
claim: 采样使用标准温度采样，温度设为 1.6 [A2.SS1.p2]。

quote: it still sees much more text during pre-training than a human sees in the their lifetime
claim: 另一个局限是预训练阶段的样本效率较差，GPT-3 在预训练中看到的文本仍远多于人类一生所见 [S5.p5]。

quote: still a fair amount lower than the overall SOTA of 85.6% achieved by the fine-tuned multi-task model ALUM
claim: 在 HellaSwag 上，GPT-3 单样本达到 78.1%、少样本达到 79.3%，超过微调的 15 亿参数语言模型的 75.4%，但仍低于微调多任务模型 ALUM 的 85.6% [S3.SS1.SSS3.p1]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves 78.1% accuracy in the one-shot setting and 79.3% accuracy in the few-shot setting, outperforming the 75.4% accuracy of a fine-tuned 1.5B parameter language model
claim: 在 HellaSwag 上，GPT-3 单样本达到 78.1%、少样本达到 79.3%，超过微调的 15 亿参数语言模型的 75.4%，但仍低于微调多任务模型 ALUM 的 85.6% [S3.SS1.SSS3.p1]。

quote: they are both expensive and inconvenient to perform inference on, which may present a challenge for practical applicability of models of this scale in their current form
claim: 此外，GPT-3 规模的模型推理既昂贵又不方便，可能对实际应用构成挑战 [S5.p7]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time, or if it simply recognizes and identifies tasks that it has learned during training
claim: 少样本学习存在不确定性：不清楚它是在推理时真正“从零”学习新任务，还是仅仅识别出训练中已学过的任务 [S5.p6]。

quote: These evaluations cover eight top-level categories: (1) commonsense reasoning; (2) knowledge; (3) reading comprehension; (4) math, reasoning, and problem solving; (5) long context; (6) code; (7) adversarial evaluations; and (8) aggregate evaluations.
claim: 论文在大量标准基准上评估预训练 Llama 3，覆盖常识推理、知识、阅读理解、数学推理、长上下文、代码、对抗评估和综合评估八大类 [S5.SS1.SSS1.p1]。

quote: Our smaller models are best-in-class, outperforming alternative models with similar numbers of parameters.
claim: 实验评估表明旗舰模型在多种任务上与 GPT-4 等领先模型表现相当，接近最先进水平，较小模型在同规模中表现最佳 [S1.p6]。

quote: We pre-train Llama 3 on a corpus of about 15T multilingual tokens, compared to 1.8T tokens for Llama 2.
claim: 预训练使用约 15T 多语言 token，旗舰模型为 405B 参数，训练计算量约 3.8×10^25 FLOPs [S1.p5]。

quote: Our Llama 3 models demonstrate perfect needle retrieval performance, successfully retrieving 100% of needles at all document depths and context lengths.
claim: 405B 模型在长上下文检索任务中实现 100% 的针检索性能 [S5.SS2.SSS6.p1]。

quote: Compared to prior versions of Llama, we improved both the quantity and quality of the data we use for pre-training and post-training.
claim: 其动机是相比前代 Llama 模型，通过提升数据数量与质量、扩大训练规模来获得更强的模型能力 [S1.p5]。

quote: we introduce the latest work Qwen2.5-VL, which continues the open-source philosophy of the Qwen series, achieving and even surpassing top-tier closed-source models on various benchmarks.
claim: 本报告旨在介绍 Qwen2.5-VL，延续 Qwen 系列的开源理念，在多项基准上达到甚至超越顶级闭源模型 [S1.p4]。

quote: on the MME-RealWorld benchmark, Qwen2.5-VL demonstrates state-of-the-art performance with a score of 63.2
claim: 在通用 VQA 上，MMBench-EN-V1.1 达到 88.4%，MMStar 达到 70.8%，MME-RealWorld 得分 63.2，MuirBench 得分 70.7 [S3.SS3.SSS1.p2][S3.SS3.SSS1.p3]。

quote: comparing it with state-of-the-art models such as Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620, GPT-4o-0513, InternVL2.5, and different sizes of Qwen2-VL.
claim: 实验将 Qwen2.5-VL 与 Claude-3.5-Sonnet-0620、GPT-4o-0513、InternVL2.5 以及不同规模的 Qwen2-VL 等当前最先进模型进行比较 [S3.SS1.p1]。

quote: It achieves 87.1% accuracy on ScreenSpot
claim: 在 GUI 定位上，ScreenSpot 达到 87.1%，ScreenSpot Pro 达到 43.6%，远超 Aguvis-72B（23.6%）和 Qwen2-VL-72B（1.6%）[S3.SS3.SSS5.p2]。

claim: 预训练的 BindGPT 在不含和含显式氢两种设置下都持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: Our main conclusion is that the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
claim: 在口袋条件生成任务上，经强化学习微调的模型能更高效地搜索结合分子空间，在结合能上显著优于此前所有最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: MatterSim employs an active learning approach to explore the extensive materials space, integrating a deep graph neural network, a materials explorer, a first-principles supervisor, and an ensemble uncertainty monitor, see Fig. 2 (a).
claim: MatterSim 采用主动学习方法探索广阔的材料空间，整合了深度图神经网络、材料探索器、第一性原理监督器和集成不确定性监测器 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: To address the limitations imposed by the level of theory of the training data, we implemented finetuning on the MatterSim model ( Fig. S44).
claim: 此外，为应对训练数据理论水平的限制，作者对 MatterSim 模型进行了微调 [S14.SS1.p1]。

quote: More importantly, when compared with experimental measurements on over 200 materials as shown in Fig. S22, it achieves an MAE of $15\text{\,}\mathrm{m}\mathrm{e}\mathrm{V}\mathrm{/}\mathrm{a}\mathrm{t}\mathrm{o}\mathrm{m}$ (see Section S11.1), lower than dedicated models directly trained on experimental data.
claim: 在自由能预测方面，与 PBE 水平的 QHA 计算相比，MatterSim 在 1000 K 以内达到低于 10 meV/atom 的误差；与 200 多种材料的实验测量相比，达到 15 meV/atom 的平均绝对误差，低于直接在实验数据上训练的专用模型 [S2.SS2.p5]。

quote: As shown in Fig. 2 (b), the curated dataset is representative of materials at temperatures and pressures covering 0– $5000\text{\,}\mathrm{K}$ and 0– $1000\text{\,}\mathrm{GPa}$.
claim: 训练数据集包含约 1700 万个经第一性原理计算标注的结构，覆盖 0–5000 K 温度和 0–1000 GPa 压力范围 [S2.SS1.p2]。

quote: Without modifying model architecture and training scheme, further increase of model parameters led to instability under current settings.
claim: 原文在训练细节中指出，在不修改模型架构和训练方案的情况下，进一步增加模型参数量会在当前设置下导致不稳定 [S1.SS4.p1]。

quote: All measurements reported as the median of 50 runs.
claim: 速度基准测试在单张 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上进行，比较大系统尺寸下 Orb 与 MACE 的前向传播速度，以及 100 原子系统在 ASE 中作为 Calculator 的端到端推理速度，所有测量取 50 次运行的中位数 [S3.F3]。

quote: Orb models are trained in two distinct phases - first they are trained as Denoising Diffusion models using a dataset of ground state materials.
claim: 模型分两阶段训练：先以基态材料数据集作为去噪扩散模型预训练，再用基础模型初始化神经网络势，以监督方式预测能量、力和应力 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: right: End to end model inference speed for a 100 atom system on a single NVIDIA A100 when implemented as a Calculator object in the Atomic Simulation Environment Python library.
claim: 速度基准测试在单张 NVIDIA A100 GPU 上进行，比较大系统尺寸下 Orb 与 MACE 的前向传播速度，以及 100 原子系统在 ASE 中作为 Calculator 的端到端推理速度，所有测量取 50 次运行的中位数 [S3.F3]。

quote: Orb models are 3-6 times faster than existing universal potentials, stable under simulation for a range of out of distribution materials
claim: Orb 模型比现有通用势快 3-6 倍，在分布外材料上模拟稳定，发布时在 Matbench Discovery 基准上误差降低 31% [abstract]。

quote: For pretraining, we curate a dataset of minimum energy configurations of materials, regardless of exchange-correlation functional, DFT software implementation or correction.
claim: 预训练数据由不同交换关联泛函、DFT 软件和校正下的最低能量构型组成，仅使用原子位置和晶胞，忽略其他属性与元数据 [S2.SS3.SSS3.p1]。

quote: With our neural network decoder, we observe $\Lambda=2.14\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.43\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$
claim: 距离-7表面码在神经网络解码器下实现Λ=2.14±0.02，每周期逻辑错误率为(1.43±0.03)×10⁻³ [S2.p5]。

quote: While many platforms have demonstrated different features of quantum error correction, no quantum processor has definitively shown below-threshold performance.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是实现低于阈值的量子纠错，即物理错误率低于临界阈值时，逻辑错误率随码距增加而指数抑制 [S1.p1]。

quote: With ensembled matching synthesis, we observe $\Lambda=2.04\pm 0.02$ and $\varepsilon_{7}$ = $(1.71\pm 0.03)\times 10^{-3}$.
claim: 作者使用神经网络解码器和集成匹配综合两种解码方法，并通过线性回归计算错误抑制因子Λ [S2.p5]。

quote: We observe that the average latency remains roughly constant at a net average of $63\pm 17$ µs independent of the length of the experiment (up to 1.1 seconds)
claim: 在实时解码下，距离-5表面码的平均解码延迟为63±17 µs，且不随实验时长（最多10⁶周期）变化 [S5.p3]。

quote: We then repeat a variable number of cycles of error correction, during which measure qubits extract parity information from the data qubits to be sent to the decoder.
claim: 作者在105量子比特处理器上实现了距离-7表面码存储，包含49个数据量子比特、48个测量量子比特和4个泄漏移除量子比特 [S2.p3]。

quote: In this paper, we report the constraints derived from the measurements of baryon acoustic oscillations with the first year of data from DESI as part of a larger series of papers.
claim: 本文旨在利用 DESI 第一年观测的 BAO 测量来约束宇宙学模型，包括平坦 ΛCDM、暗能量状态方程参数 w、w0wa 模型以及中微子质量等扩展 [abstract][S1.p8]。

quote: We however caution that this substantial tightening of the upper bound compared to the previous state-of-the-art measurements is partly driven by the preference of DESI data for a higher value of $H_{0}$.
claim: 作者指出，中微子质量上限的显著收紧部分是由 DESI 数据偏好更高的 H0 值驱动的，且上限依赖于所选的先验，在改变背景几何的扩展模型中会放宽 [S8.p8]。

quote: An important improvement in the methodology is that we now take into account the small correlation between the measurements of the auto- and the cross-correlation.
claim: 对于莱曼α森林，方法结合了森林自相关和与类星体密度的互相关测量，并考虑了自相关和互相关之间的小相关性 [S2.SS3.p6]。

quote: To mitigate confirmation bias, a blind analysis was implemented to measure the BAO scales.
claim: 论文采用盲分析来测量 BAO 尺度，以减少确认偏差 [abstract]。

quote: Moreover, the upper bound obtained depends on the priors chosen for $\sum m_{\nu}$ and, because DESI contributes through breaking a geometrical degeneracy, the upper limit is relaxed in extended models that alter the background geometry.
claim: 作者指出，中微子质量上限的显著收紧部分是由 DESI 数据偏好更高的 H0 值驱动的，且上限依赖于所选的先验，在改变背景几何的扩展模型中会放宽 [S8.p8]。

quote: There is no clear answer to this question at this time, but some speculations are given below.
claim: 论文指出，LRD 为何在 z>4 以统一的 A_V=3 mag 消光水平出现这一问题目前没有明确答案，只给出了一些推测 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: In the infrared, the SED is shaped by an extended dust and gas distribution, which allows relatively cool dust temperatures to dominate the radiation, thereby shifting the energy peak from near- to mid-infrared bands.
claim: 论文提出一个从静止系紫外到红外波段的 LRD 的 SED 模型 [S1.p6]。

quote: The UV-optical spectrum is described by dust-attenuated AGN emission, composed of a red optical continuum and a UV excess established through gray extinction.
claim: 论文提出一个从静止系紫外到红外波段的 LRD 的 SED 模型 [S1.p6]。

quote: Models with extinction laws observed in the Orion Nebula and AGN composite spectra flatten the SED with a UV slope of $\beta_{\rm UV}\sim-2$.
claim: 模型能够再现 λ≳3000-4000 Å 处斜率 β_opt≳0 的红色连续谱成分 [S2.p5]。

quote: In contrast, other models result in strongly attenuated flux that fails to maintain a UV excess.
claim: 模型能够再现 λ≳3000-4000 Å 处斜率 β_opt≳0 的红色连续谱成分 [S2.p5]。

quote: the spin correlation between the top quark and antitop quark is used to probe the effects of quantum entanglement
claim: 论文利用顶夸克-反顶夸克对的自旋关联来探测量子纠缠，通过测量由母顶夸克和反顶夸克静止系中带电轻子间夹角推断的单一观测量 D 来检测自旋纠缠 [abstract][S1.p2]。

quote: The production of $t\bar{t}$ events was modeled using the Powheg Box v2 heavy-quark (hvq) generator at next-to-leading order (NLO) precision in QCD and the events were interfaced to either Pythia 8.230 or Herwig 7.2.1
claim: 分析使用蒙特卡洛事件模拟来建模 t\bar{t} 信号和背景过程，t\bar{t} 产生用 Powheg Box v2 hvq 生成器在 NLO 精度下模拟，并接口到 Pythia 8.230 或 Herwig 7.2.1 来模拟部分子簇射和强子化 [S1.SS1.p4]。

quote: The observed result in the region with $340<m_{t\bar{t}}<380$ GeV establishes the formation of entangled $t\bar{t}$ states.
claim: 在信号区，观测和预期显著性相对于纠缠极限均远超五个标准差，且独立于用于将纠缠极限修正到测量基准相空间的蒙特卡洛模型 [S1.SS4.p4]。

quote: Currently, entanglement can only be detected with the help of a dedicated analysis in a restricted phase space like the one presented here.
claim: 论文指出，由于无法控制初始态的内部自由度，展示 t\bar{t} 对中的自旋纠缠具有挑战性，目前只能在像本文这样的受限相空间内通过专门分析来探测纠缠 [S1.p10]。

quote: However, entanglement remains largely unexplored at the highest accessible energy scales.
claim: 论文旨在探索在最高可及能量尺度上的量子纠缠，此前纠缠在从微观到宏观的广泛系统中已被观测，但在最高能量尺度上仍基本未被探索 [abstract]。

quote: By itself, this measurement does not unequivocally distinguish between MZMs in the topological phase and fine-tuned low-energy Andreev bound states in the trivial phase, but it does require the low-energy state to be supported at both ends of the wire and very weakly coupled to other low-energy states.
claim: 作者明确指出，该测量本身不能明确区分拓扑相中的马约拉纳零模与平凡相中精细调节的低能 Andreev 束缚态 [S1.p3]。

quote: Here, we focus on the left topological section of the device, shown in Fig. 1 c, and implement a parity measurement using its associated interferometer.
claim: 实验在 InAs-Al 异质结构器件上进行，作者对左拓扑段及其相关干涉仪实施宇称测量 [S2.p2]。

quote: This enables us to extract the density of non-equilibrium quasi-particles in the Al strip, yielding $n_{\mathrm{qp}}^{\mathrm{\scriptscriptstyle CPB}}\approx$0.6\text{\,}\mathrm{\SIUnitSymbolMicro m}$^{-3}$ at $B_{\parallel}=0$.
claim: 此外，作者在类似滤波和屏蔽的 Cooper pair box 器件中研究准粒子中毒，测得 B_∥=0 时非平衡准粒子密度约 0.6 µm^-3 [S3.p10]。

quote: The fusion of non-Abelian anyons or topological defects is a fundamental operation in measurement-only topological quantum computation.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是实现对一维拓扑超导体中马约拉纳零模共享费米子宇称的干涉测量，这是测量型拓扑量子计算的基本操作 [abstract][S1.p2]。

quote: In this paper, we demonstrate an interferometric measurement of the parity of a near-zero-energy state in a 1D nanowire, thereby validating a necessary ingredient of topological quantum computation.
claim: 作者称本文展示了对一维纳米线中近零能态宇称的干涉测量，从而验证了拓扑量子计算的一个必要要素 [S1.p3]。

quote: We find that the MACE-MP-0, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental viscosity across the liquid state.
claim: MACE-MP-0 开箱即用即可在整个液态范围内较准确地重现实验粘度 [abstract]。

quote: We find that the MACE-MP-0, out-of-the-box, is able to accurately reproduce the experimental viscosity across the liquid state.
claim: 验证设置是熔融 LiF 的分子动力学模拟，比较对象为 MACE-MP-0（small）与经典 Buckingham 和 Born-Huggins-Mayer 势 [abstract]。

quote: Here we report the accuracy of viscosity values calculated using the MACE potential against experimental viscosity data.
claim: 作者通过加热晶体结构来估算熔点 [abstract]，并将计算得到的粘度与实验粘度数据进行比较 [S1.p4]。

quote: Molten salts such as LiF have received long term and recent interest due to their use in solar cells, as electrolytes and solvents, and potential utilisation as coolant fluids in nuclear reactors, along with metals.
claim: 研究动机来自熔盐在太阳能电池、电解质、核反应堆冷却剂和燃料载体等方面的应用 [S1.p1]，而粘度是决定热工水力工作流体性能的关键性质 [S1.p3]。

quote: gradual heating from a crystal structure might not be generally accurate for determining the melting point
claim: 作者指出，分子模拟中熔点的确定受多种因素影响，例如周期性边界条件导致没有实验中的自由表面或界面来促进熔化，以及 MD 系统尺寸较小导致缺少长波长和低频声子 [S3.p3]。

quote: The suggested model implies an inherent degeneracy between inclination and spot location.
claim: 模拟数据基于简化的星斑模型，存在倾角与星斑位置之间的内在简并，且模型依赖先验分布，星斑分布对结果有很大影响 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote: Simulation-based learning for period determination was done only by and for predictions of TESS samples and not for Kepler samples.
claim: 作者指出，基于模拟数据的深度学习方法此前仅用于 TESS 样本的周期预测，尚未用于 Kepler 样本，且自监督学习在周期测定中从未被使用过 [S1.SS2.p1]。

quote: Using error analysis based on learned confidence and consistency metric, we were able to filter the predictions and remove stellar types with variability which is different than spot-induced variability.
claim: 通过基于学习置信度和一致性度量的误差分析，作者过滤了预测并移除了与星斑诱导变率不同的恒星类型 [abstract]。

quote: Additionally, we confirm tidal synchronization in eclipsing binaries with orbital periods shorter than 10 days.
claim: 通过基于学习置信度和一致性度量的误差分析，作者过滤了预测并移除了与星斑诱导变率不同的恒星类型 [abstract]。

quote: By leveraging a dual-branch architecture that incorporates LSTM and Transformer components, LightPred excels at capturing both temporal dependencies and global patterns within light curves.
claim: LightPred 采用双分支架构，结合 LSTM 和 Transformer 组件以同时捕捉时间依赖和全局特征 [S6.p1]。
